content_zh:

第十七章【一场法事】（2025新年快乐！
“嗯，这位先生您贵姓？不知道怎么称呼？”
，陈言倒是还挺客气，当然也是有几分好奇——不知道城里的同行都是啥情况，没打过交道。
白发中年人拿捏着姿态，缓缓笑道：“年轻人，你既然是方总的租客，也和这个房子有些因果，那就和严助理一样叫我一声青叔吧。”
白发中年人说这话的时候吧，陈言很别扭。
语气不对。
就是那种，语气语调，透着仿佛拿捏足了姿态：我可是很牛逼的，本来我看不上你的，但是我平易近人，我就吃个亏，也允许你喊我一声叔吧。
嗯，大概给人就这么一个感觉。
但……陈言不乐意了。
“不好意思啊，我家人少，没叔叔伯伯，所以打小没叫过人叔。”
，陈言淡淡道。
亲爹都不知道是谁呢，哪儿来的叔叔伯伯？
嗯，这是陈言的性格里的一点可能会被部分人觉得别扭的地方。
他一直觉得，对陌生人，要讲礼仪礼貌——是没错。
对陌生人，说您，对不熟的男人叫先生，对女人叫女士……
遇到年纪大的，叫一声老先生，老太太什么的……
也就够了。
但，至于喊人什么叔叔伯伯阿姨爷爷奶奶，他不爱轻易叫。

要么你是我家里的亲戚，那我喊你叔叔伯伯什么的，没毛病。
要么，咱两有交情，你帮过我也好，对我关照过也好，你年纪比我大，我叫你叔叔伯伯什么的，把你当长辈，应该！
要么你德高望重，比如弄水稻的那位，磕个头喊声爷爷，陈言都愿意——还觉得自己不够资格。
至于别的……什么都没有，就一陌生人？
就因为你比我大个十几二十岁，一陌生人，你到我家来，坐下来，让我喊你一声叔？
你谁啊你？
年纪大点就可以满世界让年纪小的喊你叔了？
你让他去找王校长，然后再这么“平易近人”
的对王校长说一声“你就叫我一声叔吧”
他有那个脸么？
——你可以说在这一点上陈言有点矫情，有些各色。
但没招，他就这么个性子。
白发中年人闻言有些尴尬，仿佛没想到这个年轻人会这么不给面子，清了清嗓子，眼神里那种拿捏姿态的样子也崩了一下，然后闷闷的说了句：
“老夫姓罗。”
“青叔是高人，道场就在江北栖霞山，栖霞山下洛云斋的斋主。”
，旁边严助理眼看场面有点尴尬，赶紧补充介绍。
陈言面色没动。
往小了说，什么洛云斋的，你就算是龙虎山天师也不关我事啊。

Chapter 17 [A ritual ceremony] (Happy New Year 2025!
"Well, what's your surname, sir? I don't know what to call him?"
, Chen Yan was quite polite, but of course he was also a little curious - he didn't know what the situation was like with his colleagues in the city, and he had never interacted with them.
The white-haired middle-aged man adjusted his posture and smiled slowly: "Young man, since you are Mr. Fang's tenant and have some connection with this house, then just like Assistant Yan, call me Uncle Qing."
When a white-haired middle-aged man said this, his statement was very awkward.
The tone is wrong.
It's that kind of tone, with a tone that seems to be calculated: I'm very awesome, and I didn't like you originally, but I'm approachable, so I'll suffer a loss, so you can call me uncle.
Well, that's probably the feeling it gives people.
But... Chen Yan was not happy anymore.
"Sorry, I have a small family and no uncles, so I haven't called anyone uncle since I was a child."
, Chen Yan said lightly.
I don’t even know who my biological father is, so where do these uncles come from?
Well, this is something about Chen Yan's character that some people might find awkward.
He had always felt that it was right to be polite and courteous to strangers.
To strangers, say you, to unfamiliar men, call them sir, to women, call them ma'am...
When you meet someone older, call them old sir, old lady, etc...
That's enough.
However, as for calling people uncles, aunts, grandparents, he doesn't like to call people easily.
Either you are a relative in my family, then there is nothing wrong with me calling you uncle or uncle or something like that.
Or, we have a relationship, you have helped me, or taken care of me, but you are older than me, I call you uncle, uncle, etc., and treat you as an elder, you should!
Or you are highly respected, like the rice farmer, and you are willing to kowtow, call me grandpa, and make speeches - but still feel that you are not qualified.
As for the rest... nothing, just a stranger?
Just because you are ten or twenty years older than me and a stranger, you come to my house, sit down and ask me to call you uncle?
Who are you?
When you get older, can you let the younger ones call you uncle all over the world?
You asked him to go to Principal Wang and then be so "approachable"
He said to Principal Wang, "Just call me uncle."
Does he have that face?
——You can say that the statement at this point is a bit pretentious and a bit different.
But there is no trick, he just has such a temperament.
The white-haired middle-aged man was a little embarrassed when he heard this, as if he didn't expect that this young man would be so disrespectful. He cleared his throat, and the pretentious look in his eyes collapsed, and then he said dullly:
"My surname is Luo."
"Uncle Qing is an expert. His dojo is in Qixia Mountain in the north of the Yangtze River. He is the master of Luoyunzhai at the foot of Qixia Mountain."
, Assistant Yan next to him saw that the scene was a little awkward and quickly added an introduction.
Chen Yan's expression remained unchanged.
To put it mildly, as for Luo Yunzhai, even if you are the Heavenly Master of Longhu Mountain, it is none of my business.
